title: [Keyboard Manager] Remapping temporarily stops working under high CPU load.

status.label: Confirm whether the high-load remap failure persists
status.detail: On PowerToys 0.88.0, Caps Lock mapped to Ctrl reportedly leaks the original Caps Lock behavior under heavy CPU load; related reports include #30639, while older duplicates were closed or became unreproducible.

judgment.rationale: The author reports that a Caps Lock-to-Ctrl mapping works most of the time on PowerToys 0.88.0, but occasionally the physical Caps Lock function leaks through while compiling a large Visual Studio project. The sole comment is an automated similar-issue suggestion. Older reports #27319, #22963, #24374, and #24245 are closed or stale; #30639 remains open and a commenter linked this report as a later instance, so it is relevant but does not establish that the current failure is fixed or identical. A current-version retest is the next discriminating evidence before proposing a code change.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.88.0, auto-update installation, and running as administrator.
The requested mapping is Caps Lock to Ctrl; the author says the remap works about 99% of the time but occasionally Caps Lock toggles during a large Visual Studio build.
The sole comment is an automated list of potentially similar issues and contains no author confirmation or maintainer fix.
Issues #22963 and #24374 were closed as duplicates of #27319; the author of #27319 said in 2024 that they had not experienced the issue recently.
Issue #30639 remains open and a commenter linked this report as a later occurrence, but neither thread establishes current-version behavior or a common confirmed cause.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the original Caps Lock-to-Ctrl failure still occurs on current stable under heavy CPU load; if it does, retain the exact mapping and workload details for a focused investigation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The only report is from PowerToys 0.88.0, and a related older report was explicitly closed by its author after the behavior stopped occurring. No current defect is established until the reporter retests this exact mapping on current stable.
